exec_summary: Site traffic (GA4, 2026-05-23 to 2026-05-29): growthbook.io had 11,271 sessions and 7,605 users (-21.2% week over week).

**Site performance**
- **Overall (GA4, all traffic):** 11,271 sessions (-21.2% WoW) | 7,605 users
- **Overall (GSC, organic search):** 3,401 clicks (+1.1% WoW) | 234,003 impressions (+49.8% WoW)
- **Homepage (/):** 7,692 GA4 sessions (-8.0% WoW) all-traffic | 1,834 GSC clicks (-2.9% WoW) organic | 18,665 GSC impressions (-15.5% WoW)
- **Pricing (/pricing):** 1,189 GA4 sessions (-23.8% WoW) all-traffic | 108 GSC clicks (+9.1% WoW) organic | 5,888 GSC impressions (-0.2% WoW)
- **Docs (docs.growthbook.io):** 5,320 GA4 sessions (+10.2% WoW) all-traffic | 1,176 GSC clicks (+4.7% WoW) organic | 120,205 GSC impressions (+5.5% WoW)
- **All other pages:** 4,769 GA4 sessions (-33.7% WoW) all-traffic | 310 GSC clicks (+52.7% WoW) organic | 173,908 GSC impressions (+63.3% WoW)

Pricing page: GA4 sessions down -23.8% while GSC organic clicks are up +9.1% — the GA4 drop is likely direct/paid traffic softness, not an organic problem. All-other-pages GSC impressions +63.3% is a real signal — the new insights content (401 status code, HTTP error pages) is entering Google's index at scale.

**New competitor activity**
- **Optimizely** published 15 more vertical use-case posts this week (financial services homepage/mobile/offer, healthcare homepage, retail category/checkout/homepage/product/search/subscription, B2B SaaS homepage/landing/login) plus "Powering AI With Feature Flags." This cluster has now run for six consecutive monitoring cycles. Each additional week adds indexed authority on long-tail queries GrowthBook has no equivalent content to intercept.
- **LaunchDarkly** **/solutions/run-experiments** is a new Tier 1 product page (threat score 7, KD 0) — a direct landing page for experiment-focused buyers with no keyword difficulty. LD is now creating dedicated conversion surfaces for experimenters that GrowthBook's **/products/experiments** page competes with. The **/pa/runtime/** page also surged to 1,331 ETV (+3,073% WoW — treat as a baseline-rotation artifact, but the absolute ETV is real and large).
- **LaunchDarkly** "Introducing Experiment Approvals" blog reinforces a governance + approvals narrative that GrowthBook has not directly addressed in content.
- **Harness** "A/B Testing at Scale for Platform Teams" and "Evolving Feature Management Experimentation" are direct ICP-overlap pieces — Harness is now explicitly messaging to platform engineering teams, not just DevOps/CI-CD buyers.
- **Harness** "Taming AI Code Sprawl with Harness Feature Flag Policies" (flagged last week, reappearing this run) — still no GrowthBook counter-content on AI/feature flag governance.

**New GrowthBook content**
- 10 pages noticed via sitemap this week (real publish dates unknown): **/platform/ai-native-development**, **/blog/12-common-feature-flag-mistakes-to-avoid**, **/blog/a-practitioners-guide-to-treatment-effects-...**, **/blog/amazon-to-atlassian-a-framework-for-testing-assumptions**, **/blog/best-open-source-feature-flagging-tools-compared**, **/blog/chasing-velocity-in-a-b-testing-...**, **/blog/doordash-runs-12-000-experiments-per-year-...**, **/blog/experimentation-program-mistakes-to-avoid**, **/blog/growthbook-4-4**, **/blog/growthbook-version-2-4**. None have GSC data yet.
- **/platform/ai-native-development** is the most strategically interesting — directly counters Harness and LD AI messaging if it's indexed and optimized for relevant queries.

**Organic movers worth watching**
- **/insights/status-code-what-means-how-fix** jumped from 0 to 20 clicks this week and carries 505 ETV — the insights content strategy is getting initial traction on informational queries.
- **/insights/best-open-source-feature-flagging-tools** went from 0 to 14 clicks — directly relevant to GrowthBook's ICP and likely feeding comparison-page consideration.
- **"launchdarkly business model b2b"** still at position 10.21 with 2,438 impressions and **/compare/growthbook-vs-launchdarkly** at position 8.9 with only 4 clicks. Five consecutive weeks flagged, no title-tag action taken.
- **Comparison pages:** 7-day views recovered to 9 (up from 5 last week, back within normal range). 28-day total is 40 vs. 65 prior period (-38%) — a meaningful medium-term decline even as the weekly number normalized.
- **/compare/growthbook-vs-statsig** 28-day clicks dropped from 20 to 7 (-65%) while impressions remain at 3,889 at position 7.0 — strong ranking, very low CTR. The page may need a title/meta refresh.
- **Multi-armed bandits blog** dropped from 11 to 1 click (-91%) after last week's spike. Likely a one-week anomaly but worth watching.

**Recommended actions**
- **Optimize /compare/growthbook-vs-launchdarkly title and H1 this week.** Five consecutive weeks at position 8.9 with 2,438 impressions and 4 clicks. This is the single highest-impression striking-distance fix available. Target "launchdarkly business model b2b" explicitly in the title tag.
- **Investigate /compare/growthbook-vs-statsig CTR.** Position 7.0 with 3,889 impressions over 28 days but only 7 clicks (28-day). The ranking is solid; the title/meta is not converting. A targeted refresh takes under an hour.
- **Publish one fintech A/B testing use-case page this week.** Optimizely's vertical cluster is now six monitoring cycles old. **/blog/best-open-source-feature-flagging-tools-compared** is live but the vertical angle ("A/B testing for financial services") is still missing from GrowthBook's site.
- **Confirm /platform/ai-native-development is indexed and targeting relevant queries.** LaunchDarkly and Harness are both pushing AI + feature flag governance content. GrowthBook now has a page on this topic — verify it's crawlable and optimized before competitors age into authority.

**Data quality flags**
- GSC page-split dates (2026-05-18 to 2026-05-24) lag the GA4 dates (2026-05-23 to 2026-05-29) by roughly one week — the two windows are not aligned. WoW comparisons within each source are internally consistent but cross-source comparisons should be treated with caution.
- ETV WoW percentages (e.g., LD **/pa/runtime/** at +3,073%) are likely baseline-rotation artifacts per the ongoing pipeline note. Absolute ETV values are usable; percentage swings are not.
content_recommendations: 1. Refresh /compare/growthbook-vs-launchdarkly title tag to target "launchdarkly business model b2b" directly — position 8.9, 2,438 impressions, 4 clicks this week. Five weeks of inaction on the highest-impression striking-distance query in the payload.
2. Refresh /compare/growthbook-vs-statsig title and meta description — position 7.0 with 3,889 impressions over 28 days but only 7 clicks. The ranking is earned; the click-through is broken.

3. Write "A/B Testing for Financial Services" use-case page targeting queries like "financial services experimentation" and "fintech A/B testing" — Optimizely now has at least three dedicated financial services pages (homepage, mobile, offer) aging into authority across six consecutive monitoring cycles with no GrowthBook equivalent.

4. Expand /platform/ai-native-development with explicit targeting of "AI feature flag governance" and "AI code rollout testing" queries — LaunchDarkly's /solutions/run-experiments (KD 0, threat score 7) and Harness's AI code sprawl content are both indexed. GrowthBook's new page needs to be optimized before competitors consolidate this topic.

5. Optimize /blog/best-open-source-feature-flagging-tools-compared to funnel to comparison pages — /insights/best-open-source-feature-flagging-tools is already getting 14 clicks/week at the top of the funnel. The blog post counterpart should link aggressively to /compare/* pages to capture bottom-of-funnel intent from informational traffic.
